newsitem.title: USA: JPM Co shareholders approve Denron merger.
newsitem.headline: JPM Co shareholders approve Denron merger.

text.p: JPM Co said on Wednesday that its shareholders approved the company's acquisition of privately held Denron Inc for 791,000 shares, valued at $23 million.
The final transaction is expected to close June 4, the company said.
Denron is an ISO registered manufacturer of cable assemblies and wire harnesses with principal operations in San Jose, Calif., and manufacturing support in China and Southeast Asia, JPM said.
Denron's sales for fiscal 1997, ended March 31 were approximately $26 million while JPM's sales for its latest fiscal year, ended Sept. 30, 1996 were $60 million.
